caption: The drawing depicts a single object situated centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object has a symmetrical, geometric shape resembling an abstract or stylized vase or possibly a flat ceremonial object, with a wide, rounded base tapering upwards to a narrow, straight-edged top, and angular shoulders between the base and the top. The main surface of the object is textured and mottled, predominantly rusty brown in color, interspersed with patches of darker brown, black, and some lighter tan tones. The surface is uneven in hue, with speckles and blotches creating a variegated appearance. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the image. The signature "Harvey Beck 1939" is lightly written in small, neat script at the top left corner.
title: Ship Builder's Axe Head
